beats.text: Trump wants the Smithsonian to talk less about slavery and more about, quote, 'Brightness.'

beats.caption: America's brightness and not, quote, how bad slavery was.
beats.label: via WHAS11

beats.text: That's barely half of it. He says the whole place is basically out of control.

beats.caption: targeted the Smithsonian museums, saying they are, quote, out of control
beats.label: via Good Morning America

beats.text: Historians were not exactly clapping. One MSNBC analyst did not hold back.

beats.caption: And frankly, it would be obscene. It would be an obscenity.
beats.label: via MSNBC

beats.text: Funny thing: back in twenty seventeen, Trump toured that very African American history museum himself.

beats.caption: He called it a quote truly great museum done with love.
beats.label: via Good Morning America

beats.text: PolitiFact checked his 'nothing about Success' line and rated it Pants Fire. So brightness, apparently, starts with him.
